conditions.passCriterion: At least 3 of 5 KILL or STRUCT_FAIL
conditions.minimumRefinement: If chosen first point >30km, fill integer points between its preceding failed point and first pass; re-form runs and choose the farthest-ending run
conditions.otherRunsPolicy: Preserve all other sampled contiguous pass runs; do not use for ring
conditions.deadZonesPolicy: Consecutive failing sampled points between pass runs; record leading/trailing failures separately

previousDefinition.storage: Exact preceding row in previous; earlier D2 history remains nested
